moments.title: Strictly's Icons Week
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is gearing up for its popular 'Icons Week' on Saturday, October 17th, where celebrities will embody famous figures in their routines.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready to see your favourite celebs pay tribute to legends! Strictly Come Dancing's 'Icons Week' is just around the corner on October 17th. Who are you hoping they'll channel?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are shaking things up on Strictly this year! What do you think of the new presenting line-up as we head towards Icons Week on Oct 17th? #Strictly2026

moments.title: October Half Term Kicks Off
moments.blurb: School's out for October half-term in Scotland (Oct 12-16) and Wales (Oct 12-23), with England and Northern Ireland's break starting later in the month.

angles.name: Wales & Scotland Start
angles.copy: Half Term alert! If you're in Wales, the kids are off from October 12-23. Scotland, yours is Oct 12-16. What are your plans for the school break?

angles.name: General UK Heads Up
angles.copy: The October half-term hols are officially underway for many in Scotland and Wales from Oct 12th! England and NI, your turn is coming later in the month. Enjoy the break!
